## History

Julia Bell attended school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), participating in the daily life and gossip of the classroom. She was present during the tenure of the severe teacher Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and later continued her education under Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), who involved the students in activities like organizing a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert. As she grew older, Julia joined the local Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), attending meetings where members debated community issues such as unwanted public advertisements.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV.
